prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic soft morning bedroom portrait with a clean white tied shirt, light denim and airy natural bokeh.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long flowing blonde hair in loose natural waves, blue eyes, fair natural skin with subtle blush and minimal makeup. She wears a clean white short-sleeve cotton shirt tied at the waist and light-wash high-waisted jeans, with relaxed shoulders and a calm direct expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 portrait from the waist upward or seated at the edge of a neatly made bed. Keep the adult woman facing camera with natural posture. Include white and cream bedding, light wooden bed frame, minimal modern decor, a nearby window with sheer curtains and soft bedroom furniture.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright soft natural morning or late-afternoon light creates gentle highlights on hair and cotton texture with quiet shadows. Keep the mood peaceful, cozy, clean and intimate in a non-explicit lifestyle sense.
prompt.technical_specs: Canon DSLR 50mm f/1.8 portrait look, shallow depth of field, sharp eyes and face, realistic hair strands, cotton and denim texture, creamy natural bokeh, true-to-life color and no artificial flash.
